children: Nike adds luxury-brand expertise to its board with the appointment of Alexandre Arnault, deputy CEO of Moët Hennessy. Arnault spent four years as executive vice president at Tiffany & Co., where he led a revitalization of the brand. Before that, he led RIMOWA as CEO for four years after spearheading LVMH's acquisition of the luggage maker. Nike Executive Chairman Mark Parker said Arnault has a reputation for helping iconic global brands evolve and innovate. Arnault's experience will "strengthen our connection with consumers, sharpen our competitive edge and accelerate Nike's next chapter of growth," said President and CEO Elliott Hill.
